import sys
import heapq
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    idx = 1
    
    price_map = {}
    products = set()
    
    for i in range(n):
        if idx + 1 >= len(data):
            break
        name = data[idx]
        price = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
        
        if name in price_map:
            old_price = price_map[name]
            price_map[name] = price
        else:
            price_map[name] = price
            products.add(name)
    
    sorted_products = sorted(products)
    print("Products (sorted):", " ".join(sorted_products), end=" \n")
    
    if price_map:
        max_price = max(price_map.values())
        print("Highest Price:", max_price)
    else:
        print("Highest Price: 0")
    
    count = sum(1 for p in price_map.values() if p > 1000)
    print("Products above 1000:", count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
